note: Notes for the command list (docs/command_list.md). Every move in the fighter's data shows up by itself; here, keyed by the ENGINE move name, you can add a display name, description, tags, a shown input, preview states, a group to merge into, or hide a move.

6C.name: Devil Uppercut
6C.desc: Rising devil-arm uppercut: launches. Any normal cancels into it; jump (8) on hit to chase.

Shade Wave.desc: A wave of shadow rolls along the floor.

Twin Shade.desc: Two waves, one after the other.

Umbral Wall.desc: Invincible start. A wall of energy pushes slowly forward: three hits, the last throws them sky-high.

Event Horizon.desc: A black hole opens close in front of him (A) or far away (B) and waits about 5 seconds. Touching it: the near one launches them away, the far one throws them toward him. Both holes can be out at once: A again sets off the near one, B again the far one.

Twin Horizon.desc: Both holes, invincible start: the far one collapses at once and throws them toward him, into the near one.

Collapse.desc: With both kinds of hole out (or after Twin Horizon), 41236C: a finger snap that sets off every waiting hole.

Void Grasp.desc: Low grab lunge. On hit he drains them and stocks the energy.

Abyss Hammer.desc: Jumping overhead smash with the devil arm (also in the air). On the ground, 214 + B again on hit or block = Abyss Riser.

Abyss Riser.desc: Rising uppercut (not an overhead) that launches. Jump-cancellable on hit (air jump), or air attacks, to keep the combo going.

Void Devour.desc: Invincible lunge: grabs the face, drains, and the explosion blows them away. Stocks the energy.

Overflow Ray.desc: With energy stocked, any 214 fires a quick three-hit beam (+15 on block). Uses the stock.

Fallen Grasp.desc: Air grab: drags them down into a ground explosion, then drains them and stocks the energy.

Raging Storm.desc: Charge, ground slam, a storm of purple fire around him, then the last burst throws them away.

God Press.desc: Sliding grab: carries them to the wall, three slams, then a blast that knocks him back onto one knee.

Throw.desc: Close range. 4 + B+C throws behind you.

Air Throw.desc: Throw in the air, close range.

Collapse A.name: Collapse (near)
Collapse A.desc: Event Horizon A again while the near hole is waiting: snap, the near hole sucks them in and bursts. The far hole stays.

Collapse B.name: Collapse (far)
Collapse B.desc: Event Horizon B again while the far hole is waiting: snap, the far hole sucks them in and bursts. The near hole stays.
